clusters.headline: President Trump Signals End Of Military Operations Against Iran
aiSummaryBullets: President Trump stated that military engagement with Iran is effectively over, citing positive momentum toward a resolution.
Global oil prices dropped to their lowest levels since August following the president's remarks on the de-escalation of the conflict.

clusters.headline: Explosions Reported In Strait Of Hormuz Amidst Diplomatic Efforts
aiSummaryBullets: Explosions were reported on Qeshm Island and on tankers following encounters with sea mines in the Strait of Hormuz.
Iran has officially removed the previous 2,000-kilometer range restriction on its ballistic missile program.
